fact: Car 18 left the track at Turn 18 in Lap 33 without a justifiable reason.
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. It was evident that Car 18 left the track at Turn 18 on Lap 33 without a justifiable reason. This was the driver's fourth track limits infringement of the race. The standard penalty for a fourth track limits infringement during the race is a 5 second time penalty. The Stewards therefore imposed the standard penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Leaving The Track Multiple Times 2
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
